items.explain: The engine at depth 16 rates 14.Nh5 best, at least 0.6 pawn above 14.f5. The knight on h5 attacks f6 and g7. Two black pieces guard h7, the king and the knight on f6; if that knight takes on h5, only the king guards h7.
